Tallgrass Fictional Energy - company overview (FICTIONAL DEMO DOCUMENT)

This is invented sample content for a software demo. Tallgrass Fictional Energy does not exist.

Tallgrass Fictional Energy is an independent oil and gas company headquartered in Redbank City. It
was founded in 2011 and employs 140 people. Its only producing asset is Kestrel Field in the Marrow
Basin. The Heron Creek prospect is under evaluation and has no production.

The Chief Financial Officer is Priya Anand. Reserves are updated every quarter, and the update is
published in the second week after the quarter ends.
